messages.text: Morning all. Seeing 11 FX breaks on the overnight recon, mostly GBP/USD and EUR/USD spot trades from yesterday afternoon. Anyone else seeing the same?
Yep, same here. Looks like the cash legs are in GLCore but the trade-side amounts are off by small deltas. Mostly under $500 each.
Wire room has 2 of those tied to outgoing wires. Should I hold them or let them go while we investigate?
Let them go if the wire amounts match the confirms. The delta looks like a rate rounding issue, not a cash problem.
Does anyone know if ReconLegacy picks up the FX rate snapshot at 4pm or at end of day? The deltas smell like a stale rate to me.
I don't know the ReconLegacy internals at all, honestly. @Priya Raman is the one who knows the Perl jobs and the cron schedule.

Just got in. Rate snapshot is pulled by the Perl job on the Oracle 11g side, cron fires at 21:30 ET nightly. It takes the last stored rate, not a 4pm fix. So anything booked after the last rate load uses the earlier value.
That would explain it. The GBP trades were booked around 4:45pm. Is the rate load a separate job?
Yes, separate job, runs at 17:00 ET. Anything booked after that gets the 17:00 rate. Checking last night's logs now to confirm it didn't fail.
FYI for the channel: please route any ReconLegacy questions through a ticket and tag Priya, so we have a trail. Thanks Priya for jumping on this.

Confirmed. The 17:00 rate load ran fine, but the source table was missing the late London fixing rows. So it's a data gap, not a job failure. I can backfill the rates and rerun the recon step for FX only.
Please do. Will the rerun overwrite the manual adjustments Craig already posted in GLCore?
No, the rerun only rewrites the recon match tables, it doesn't touch GLCore postings. I'll start it around 11:00 ET and post here when it finishes.
I'll open a ticket for the missing London fixing rows upstream so it doesn't repeat. Will link it here once it's filed.
